Assign trainable latent vectors $v_l[i,j,k]$ (dim 2) to grid vertices corresponding to occupied voxels.

*   Memory usage depends on the number of hash table entries and grid levels.
Explicit surface normal prediction enables relighting.
Assumes view-independent appearance and opaque meshes.
*   When converting existing mesh assets (e.g., from Objaverse, Poly Haven) to NeRFs for robotics or simulation.
*   When explicit normals are needed for shading/relighting.
*   When photometric accuracy (PSNR) is the primary metric.
*   For scenes with translucent objects or view-dependent effects (e.g., glossy reflections).
It builds on the principles of [Radiance-field optimization](44-radiance-field-optimization.md) but diverges by using mesh-derived ground truth instead of image-based optimization.
